the true opening line and the closing line (only the captures the engine took)
automatic injury and lineup information (no free source permits automated reading; only attributable recorded reports are used, and a team with none is shown as NOT AVAILABLE, never as healthy)
game total / scoring environment (only moneyline and puck-line markets are captured)
a validated expected-goal-margin or variance estimate beyond the goal-margin calibration of the win probability
availability.note: The Odds API (the only odds source) returns prices, not betting splits; scraping a splits site would be a terms-of-service risk and is not done. Price movement is market information; it is not called sharp money.

PICK_OUTSIDE_PREFERRED_PRICE.describes: daily bets priced outside the preferred region

PICK_OWN_MATERIAL_ABSENCE.describes: daily bets where the picked team was missing a MATERIAL player (fresh attributable report) at decision time

PICK_PUCK_LINE.describes: daily bets that were puck lines

context_confirmation.note: Daily Faceoff's public starting-goalies page can be read automatically (operational/dailyfaceoff.py; OFF until the owner opts in because the site's network terms restrict automated access). A start counts as CONFIRMED only with an identifiable source (the team, or a recognized beat reporter, with a name and link), a fresh timestamp and text that names the goalie, and no later report naming another goalie. A person can also record a confirmation with its source and time (operational/goalie_confirmations.py).

eligibility.note: The starter gate is unchanged and not bypassed: a leg exists only for a goalie with a recorded (team-post or manual) confirmation.

projection.note: goalie-team-v1: raw probabilities beat both baselines at every threshold 20+ to 35+ on the held-out 2025-26 season; the fitted calibration did not help, so it is not used (docs/validation/goalie_team_validation.json).

settlement.note: GOALIE_SAVES_<k>PLUS; a goalie who does not play voids that leg.

eligibility.note: Eligible whenever the T-35 evaluation has a valid quote and clears its own edge/EV gates; if the strict gate were ever enabled, the adapter reports WAIT.

prices.note: h2h is pulled every 2 minutes, but the T-35 evaluation only accepts a quote for its evaluation time (about 35 minutes before puck drop); earlier it reports DATA_UNAVAILABLE (no valid quote as of that time). That is today's actual exclusion reason.

projection.note: The T-35 Elo model (its band is a heuristic) drives pricing. The strength model (goalie-team-v1) shown on Games was compared with it chronologically on the same games (docs/validation/moneyline_model_comparison.json): nominally ahead in both folds, but the paired interval includes zero in both, and neither is shown to beat a sportsbook price. It is therefore NOT promoted. A versioned opt-in switch and a prospective shadow log (operational/moneyline_model_path.py) collect the market-inclusive evidence.

models.name: Skater matchup projection
models.purpose: Expected time on ice, power-play time, shots, goals, assists, points, hits and blocks per player and opponent; threshold probabilities for shots (1+ to 5+), points (1+, 2+), goals (1+), assists, hits, blocks.

validation.method: Chronological walk; train 2022-24 fit, calibration season 2024-25 (dispersion, Platt), final evaluation 2025-26 scored once; compared with the recent 30-game rate and the previous live formula; Brier, log loss, calibration tables, limited-history and changed-role slices.

data.source: MoneyPuck goalie logs + NHL.com season records

limits: The starter must be confirmed: a saves leg exists only for a goalie whose start is confirmed by the team's own post (read automatically from Daily Faceoff) or recorded by hand; a beat reporter's 'Confirmed' is kept as an expectation unless the owner opts in. The gate is not bypassed.
The fitted calibration did not improve held-out log loss, so raw probabilities are used.
models.name: Goalie saves and goals against
models.purpose: Expected shots against, save percentage, saves and goals against for a named goalie and opponent, with an 80% range and a saves ladder 24+ to 34+.

limits: The named-goalie adjustment did not improve held-out forecasts; it is a scenario, not the probability.

Puck line: a margin model built on this strength rating (Poisson goals) did NOT beat the base-rate baseline on held-out games (over-predicts home -1.5 covers); that result stays on record. A direct-logistic alternative beats the base rate on two earlier development folds, but nothing is enabled until it is scored on games it has never seen (2026-27, collecting) and prices and settlement exist.

Moneyline: this model is NOT what prices tickets; the Elo path (heuristic band) does. On the same games the two are statistically indistinguishable (docs/validation/moneyline_model_comparison.json) and neither is shown to beat a sportsbook price, so no promotion was made. A versioned opt-in switch and a shadow scoreboard (below) collect market-inclusive evidence on live games.
models.name: Team strength and win probability
models.purpose: Home/away win probability from decayed goal differential (shootouts counted in the result for display).

puck_line.event: home -1.5 covers (wins by 2+); away +1.5 is its complement

eggy.headline: OFFICIAL EGGY FLAGSHIP PARLAY (UNPRICED)
notes: Stage A looks at the whole real slate and never records anything; stage B (the production recording policy) is unchanged and is the only source of a recorded paper bet.
Joint probabilities and combined prices of same-game candidates are NOT claimed; see each candidate's dependence section.
The support score ranks candidates; it is not a probability and not value.
Moneyline legs are included without stage B's model-agreement requirement: a candidate is a thesis to look at, not a qualified pick.

blockers: SAME-GAME DEPENDENCE: no joint model has been validated for these legs, so no joint probability is claimed (the legs are positively dependent: teammates shots)

NO COMBINED PRICE: the feed carries single-leg lines only (The Odds API lists no same-game-parlay market); DraftKings prices same-game parlays with its own correlation model, and multiplying the legs' prices is not an offered price
PRODUCTION POLICY: recorded tickets are cross-game only; a same-game ticket would need a validated joint model AND a quoted combined price

ticket_policy.summary: up to 1 ticket a day (zero is allowed); each +100 or better and no longer than +500, 2 to 5 legs (the fewest that qualify), every leg from a different game; legs are well supported (2+ shots for a player who reaches the line in most of his last 30 games, or a moneyline at the market's own chance), never points or goal bets; estimated hit chance of at least 30%; estimated value of at least +5%, at least +3% after lowering every leg by 3 points, and not negative if the true chance is halfway between the player's record and the price; ranked by estimated hit chance; each player on at most 1 ticket a day
